responsibility: This file contains small debugging helpers for inspecting GCC trees built by the Modula-2 frontend. It wraps debug_tree for single nodes and chains and can dump the current statement list from m2block, so its responsibility is developer-facing introspection of frontend-generated tree IR rather than semantic lowering.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the m2misc group: it contains the actual debug_tree and statement-list dumping helpers, whereas m2misc.h only declares those utilities and m2misc.def exposes a reduced Modula-2-facing interface.
